name: Claro MC Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists one Grosuplje colocation facility, Claro MC Data Center, at Industrijska cesta 1, 1290 Grosuplje. No official operator page, MW capacity, or build/launch date was found in public search, so this is treated as aggregate evidence only.

name: 5G WAT-ERR-IB edge computing/private 5G smart municipality project
developer: Vahta d.o.o.; Municipality of Ilirska Bistrica
notes: Official Vahta project page describes a 2025-2027, EUR 4.9 million project in Municipality of Ilirska Bistrica using private 5G SA, IoT sensors, LoRaWAN, drones, and edge computing for local real-time processing. HaDEA lists the project under CEF Digital 5G and Edge Cloud for Smart Communities with EUR 3.735 million EU contribution. This is an edge-cloud/telecom infrastructure project rather than a conventional colocation or hyperscale data center; no MW capacity found.
